lines.trans: What happened here? Answer immediately!
Everything is fine, dear Uncle Misha.
Our agent was wearing body armor.
Why did you let him go alone?
You were just sitting in your van!
I will report about this to the general now!
Uncle Misha, I am to blame for everything myself.
I should have called them right away.
But I didn't call.
I severely underestimated the real danger.
I committed a very foolish act.
You acted extremely recklessly, Sokolov.
I promise this will not happen again.

examples.trans: Our agent was wearing body armor.
A secret agent arrived in town.
We need to do even more.
The police officers put on bulletproof vests before the operation.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: short forms виноват / виновата / виноваты are used for 'it's my/your fault'

examples.text: Я ни в чём не виноват.
examples.trans: I'm not to blame for anything.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

meanings.note: a high military or security-service rank

examples.trans: Put me through to the general.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

meanings.en: to report formally to a superior

examples.text: Я сейчас доложу об этом генералу!
examples.trans: I will report about this to the general now!
The captain reported the squad's arrival.

meanings.note: to a loved one, and at the start of letters
masculine, but declined like a feminine noun in -я
colloquial, as children say; дяди из Москвы = some people from Moscow

звонить.gloss: to call, to phone; to ring

meanings.en: extremely, exceptionally, to a high degree

examples.trans: It was an extremely dangerous experiment.
One must not treat the matter frivolously.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

meanings.en: to underestimate, fail to appreciate full extent of

examples.trans: I severely underestimated the real danger.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом
+ dative of the person: обещать вам
agrees in gender and case with the noun

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: state of being exposed to harm

examples.trans: He did not understand the real danger.

examples.text: В горах всегда существует опасность обвала.
examples.trans: In the mountains there is always a danger of rockfall.

meanings.en: to answer, to reply, to pick up the phone

examples.text: Я вам звоню, а вы не отвечаете!
examples.trans: I call you, and you don't answer!

examples.text: Почему ты не отвечаешь на мои вопросы?
examples.trans: Why aren't you answering my questions?
I love our town very much.

examples.text: Ошибка не должна повториться в будущем.
examples.trans: The mistake must not repeat in the future.

поступить.gloss: to enter, to get into (a university); to act

examples.trans: Yulia needs to get into university.
I committed a very foolish act.

examples.text: Это был благородный и смелый поступок.
examples.trans: It was a noble and brave deed.
Why are we going so slowly?

meanings.note: usually 3rd person: что произошло? = what happened?

examples.text: Я не знаю, как это произошло.
examples.trans: I don't know how it happened.
There exists a real security threat.

examples.text: Мы ищем реальный выход из кризиса.
examples.trans: We are looking for a real way out of the crisis.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.trans: Why are you sitting in the corner?
The wind is blowing hard outside.

meanings.note: a formal, bookish verb; used jokingly about everyday things
совершить ошибку = to make a mistake

examples.trans: Daddy's already had his cold dip.
You can see it at once.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: I will move the van away for now.

examples.text: Большой белый фургон стоял у ворот.
examples.trans: A large white van was parked by the gates.
I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
